lessons.title: From a mark to a packet
lessons.scope: Parsing checks syntax. It does not assign physical meaning or approve a move.

lessons.title: Adding structure without erasing evidence
lessons.scope: This embedding is one declared construction. It does not establish licensed ascent through 100 levels.

lessons.title: Two arrows need matching endpoints
lessons.scope: These are finite named cells; a matching boundary is not an equivalence of arbitrary categories.

lessons.title: Choosing a measure changes the winner
lessons.scope: The costs are pedagogical fixtures. They do not replay external Genesis Reading L/F evidence.

lessons.title: Transport a packet and detect changed bytes
lessons.scope: The DAG serializer has a declared restricted JSON form. Sorted JSON alone is not a general RFC 8785 implementation.

lessons.title: Condition on a grammar's retained tokens
lessons.scope: Weights are declared exact fixtures, not measured neural logits. This does not run a language model or assess answer truth.

lessons.title: Connect skills by their input and output types
lessons.scope: This exercises structural composition and declared capability slices. It does not admit new production skills.

lessons.title: A potential repair leaves cycle sum unchanged
lessons.scope: Only a declared directed triangle is checked. No physical field or neural state is inferred.

lessons.title: Check a boundary before trusting a chain law
lessons.scope: The constructor checks boundary completeness, and the independent basis audit checks the chain law. Neither check replaces the other.

lessons.title: Certify a candidate with both sides of an LP
lessons.scope: This verifies a supplied certificate for a three-edge rational LP. It does not run an optimizer or classify all LPs.

lessons.title: Changing quantifier order changes the question
lessons.scope: Finite exhaustive checks do not establish an infinite hierarchy separation or a result about model reasoning.

lessons.title: Enumerate the finite obstruction independently
lessons.scope: This is a classical binary constraint model. It does not establish a quantum Hamiltonian sign-free basis.

lessons.title: Compute a four-simplex volume from squared lengths
lessons.scope: A determinant on a declared distance table does not construct a curved four-manifold or establish continuum field equations.

lessons.title: Separate an intersection pairing from its geometric interpretation
lessons.scope: The existing dossier's exact-gauge path assigns its zero 4-cochain directly. This lesson does not count that assignment as a computed cup product, Pontryagin class, or Rust replay.

lessons.title: Track which obstruction changed, not just how many remain
lessons.scope: This is declared survivor accounting. It does not certify that the chosen lift resolves a real derivation obligation.

lessons.title: Compute a finite transfer shadow without extending its meaning
lessons.scope: This computes a finite determinant identity. A connection to Ihara zeta, prime spectra, or continuum dynamics needs additional assumptions and separate evidence.

lessons.title: Keep catalog coverage separate from derivation depth
lessons.scope: The empty lift list is a lesson fixture. External Genesis depth must be refreshed from its own receipts; this notebook does not certify those repositories.

lessons.title: An antibody detects a problem without approving a repair
lessons.scope: The recursive Python detector is a named lesson model, not the Rust pharmacy. A retired verifier returns a typed refusal, not a valid admission. Production detector execution and promotion require separate source-bound evidence.

lessons.title: Select prompt candidates only after bounded gates
lessons.scope: This is selection over declared finite outcomes, not learned prompt performance. No admission, production evolution, or OpenRouter benchmark is claimed.

lessons.title: Make a coverage statement that can be checked
lessons.scope: The crosswalk includes the canonical Level Engine owners and preserved v1 history. It is a file-by-file navigation and evidence inventory, not an assertion that every source has been read or executed. New or changed files require refreshing it.
